messages.text: How do changes in radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

### Short answer [19][20]
Radar evolution is not stated in the passages as a direct formal requirement for Signaling / Non-signaling Testers, but the supported trend is that radar/sensing moving into communications raises needs around high bandwidth, waveform design, spectrum coexistence, power density, and radar-equation-related validation; separately, current signaling/non-signaling testers are described as needing FR1/FR2, mmWave, OTA/radiated, RF parametric, waveform, MIMO, and transmitter/receiver measurement capabilities [19][20][7][34][36].
### Supported changes in radar / sensing technology [19][20][58]
| Change in radar / sensing technology | Measurement capability implication for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| ISAC integrates sensing capability into communications networks, and its challenges include high bandwidth, radar equation, power density, spectrum coexistence, and waveform design [19] | A tester aimed at this space would need to cover communications plus sensing-related RF/waveform behavior rather than only conventional protocol or RF checks [19] |
| MFSS may combine communications and radar sensing through a joint waveform [20] | A tester would need waveform-generation/analysis capability that can handle communication-plus-radar-sensing waveform concepts, not just separate communication waveforms [20] |
| Automotive radar echo generation uses dynamic artificial object generation, with hybrid analog stepped delay for short ranges and fully digital implementation for longer ranges up to 3000 m; the digital concept is used for FMCW radar [2] | Radar validation capability shifts toward dynamic echo/object emulation, FMCW handling, and distance-range emulation rather than static RF-only measurements [2] |
| AREG800A radar-related specs include 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz instantaneous IF bandwidth, automotive radar bands at 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz and 76 GHz to 81 GHz, and Doppler/radial-velocity support [58] | Radar-related measurement capability therefore needs to keep up with wider IF bandwidths, mmWave automotive radar bands, and Doppler/velocity-related behavior [58] |
| AREG800A supports dynamic RCS range and RCS control step size, including 90 dB dynamic RCS range for all artificial objects on one IF path with listed frontends and 0.1 dB RCS control step size [54] | Radar-related measurement capability may need controllable target-strength/RCS behavior, not only frequency, power, or modulation measurements [54] |
### Tester-side capabilities stated in the passages [7][34][36]
| Tester type / product line | Measurement capabilities explicitly stated | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Signaling tester: R&S CMX500 | Universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting 5G NR, LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD; it also provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements [7] | [7] |
| Signaling tester: R&S CMX500 with FR2 setup | FR2 testing can use CMXHEAD30, CMXHEAD50, or CMXHEAD50-Evo remote radio heads, which upconvert/downconvert between IF and 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges; the split concept supports short RF cable lengths for radiated chamber test environments [9] | [9] |
| Non-signaling tester: R&S CMP200 | CMP200 with CMPHEAD30/CMPHEAD50 forms a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution, and targets RF parametric testing, high-volume RF parametric testing, pure radiated mmWave setups, and mixed radiated/conducted setups [35][36] | [35][36] |
| Non-signaling tester: R&S CMP200 NR FR2 options | NR FR2 measurement options include single-carrier, multicarrier, and two-RX-antenna/switched-MIMO measurements; common settings include 1 to 4 carriers, FR2 bands n257/n258/n259/n260/n261/n262, 50/100/200/400 MHz channel bandwidth, and 60/120 kHz subcarrier spacing [34] | [34] |
| Network-infrastructure measurement context | Active antennas and Massive MIMO make measured systems more complex, higher frequencies make conducted testing impractical, far-field measurements need sophisticated T&M solutions, and OTA testing becomes necessary under higher frequencies / Massive MIMO [25] | [25] |
### Inference lines [19][20][34][36][58]
【推論】As radar/sensing moves toward ISAC and joint communication-radar waveforms, Signaling Testers such as CMX500 would need stronger waveform, RF, and FR1/FR2 measurement coverage if they are used for communication systems that include sensing functions [19][20][7].
【推論】As radar moves to wider bandwidth and mmWave operation, Non-signaling Testers such as CMP200 would need wideband FR2/mmWave RF parametric, OTA/radiated, multicarrier, and multi-antenna measurement capability when the DUT is a mmWave communications device with sensing-adjacent requirements [34][36][58].

R&S AREG800A › 文件與適用條件
- 來源文件：[[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]]。
- 文件編號：`PD 3609.8015.22`。
- 文件版本：`Version 09.00`。
- 文件日期：`September 2025（LA）`。
- 文件名稱：`AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`。
- Copyright：`© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。
- 資料註記：無 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力；資料 `subject to change`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 於環境溫度儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- `Specifications with limits`：以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示保證產品性能。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：表示保證產品性能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依 GUM 計算。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

R&S AREG800A › R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D
RF transfer characteristics 量測條件：with diplexer between RX and TX，frequency step size `2.5 MHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`，window function normal gate（Hann），type bandpass filter，measured from RX waveguide input to waveguide TX output connector。

6G NTN 展望 › Two-stage network access model
來源引述 [[6G-TakeOff]] 提出 UE network access 的 two-stage model：

| Stage | 功能 |
|---|---|
| Anchor part | 提供 downlink synchronization signals、system information、uplink random access；適合 camping、first access、initial connectivity。 |
| Dynamic part | 由 non-permanently visible dynamic cells 組成；較適合 connected mode，UE initial access 後由 network handover 到 dynamic node。 |

此模型的動機是降低 UE 在 idle mode 長時間掃描 dynamic network nodes 的 power consumption。

### Short answer [19][20]
Radar evolution is not stated in the passages as a direct formal requirement for Signaling / Non-signaling Testers, but the supported trend is that radar/sensing moving into communications raises needs around high bandwidth, waveform design, spectrum coexistence, power density, and radar-equation-related validation; separately, current signaling/non-signaling testers are described as needing FR1/FR2, mmWave, OTA/radiated, RF parametric, waveform, MIMO, and transmitter/receiver measurement capabilities [19][20][7][34][36].
### Supported changes in radar / sensing technology [19][20][58]
| Change in radar / sensing technology | Measurement capability implication for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| ISAC integrates sensing capability into communications networks, and its challenges include high bandwidth, radar equation, power density, spectrum coexistence, and waveform design [19] | A tester aimed at this space would need to cover communications plus sensing-related RF/waveform behavior rather than only conventional protocol or RF checks [19] |
| MFSS may combine communications and radar sensing through a joint waveform [20] | A tester would need waveform-generation/analysis capability that can handle communication-plus-radar-sensing waveform concepts, not just separate communication waveforms [20] |
| Automotive radar echo generation uses dynamic artificial object generation, with hybrid analog stepped delay for short ranges and fully digital implementation for longer ranges up to 3000 m; the digital concept is used for FMCW radar [2] | Radar validation capability shifts toward dynamic echo/object emulation, FMCW handling, and distance-range emulation rather than static RF-only measurements [2] |
| AREG800A radar-related specs include 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz instantaneous IF bandwidth, automotive radar bands at 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz and 76 GHz to 81 GHz, and Doppler/radial-velocity support [58] | Radar-related measurement capability therefore needs to keep up with wider IF bandwidths, mmWave automotive radar bands, and Doppler/velocity-related behavior [58] |
| AREG800A supports dynamic RCS range and RCS control step size, including 90 dB dynamic RCS range for all artificial objects on one IF path with listed frontends and 0.1 dB RCS control step size [54] | Radar-related measurement capability may need controllable target-strength/RCS behavior, not only frequency, power, or modulation measurements [54] |
### Tester-side capabilities stated in the passages [7][34][36]
| Tester type / product line | Measurement capabilities explicitly stated | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Signaling tester: R&S CMX500 | Universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting 5G NR, LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD; it also provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements [7] | [7] |
| Signaling tester: R&S CMX500 with FR2 setup | FR2 testing can use CMXHEAD30, CMXHEAD50, or CMXHEAD50-Evo remote radio heads, which upconvert/downconvert between IF and 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges; the split concept supports short RF cable lengths for radiated chamber test environments [9] | [9] |
| Non-signaling tester: R&S CMP200 | CMP200 with CMPHEAD30/CMPHEAD50 forms a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution, and targets RF parametric testing, high-volume RF parametric testing, pure radiated mmWave setups, and mixed radiated/conducted setups [35][36] | [35][36] |
| Non-signaling tester: R&S CMP200 NR FR2 options | NR FR2 measurement options include single-carrier, multicarrier, and two-RX-antenna/switched-MIMO measurements; common settings include 1 to 4 carriers, FR2 bands n257/n258/n259/n260/n261/n262, 50/100/200/400 MHz channel bandwidth, and 60/120 kHz subcarrier spacing [34] | [34] |
| Network-infrastructure measurement context | Active antennas and Massive MIMO make measured systems more complex, higher frequencies make conducted testing impractical, far-field measurements need sophisticated T&M solutions, and OTA testing becomes necessary under higher frequencies / Massive MIMO [25] | [25] |
### Inference lines [19][20][34][36][58]
【推論】As radar/sensing moves toward ISAC and joint communication-radar waveforms, Signaling Testers such as CMX500 would need stronger waveform, RF, and FR1/FR2 measurement coverage if they are used for communication systems that include sensing functions [19][20][7].
【推論】As radar moves to wider bandwidth and mmWave operation, Non-signaling Testers such as CMP200 would need wideband FR2/mmWave RF parametric, OTA/radiated, multicarrier, and multi-antenna measurement capability when the DUT is a mmWave communications device with sensing-adjacent requirements [34][36][58].

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

6G NTN 展望 › ISAC
[[ISAC]] 將 sensing capability 整合進 communications network。

- satellite sensing 可為 active / passive、imaging / non-imaging、monostatic / bistatic / multistatic。
- ISAC 可能支援 drones、transportation、refrigerated logistics、rural sensing 等 multi-operator collaboration use cases。
- challenge 包含 high bandwidth、radar equation、power density、spectrum coexistence 與 waveform design。

6G NTN 展望 › Multi-function satellite services（MFSS）
[[MFSS]] 是將 communications、navigation、earth observation、monitoring、sensing 等 satellite services 整合的概念。

- Phase 1：同一 satellite 整合多個獨立 hardware / services。
- Phase 2：可能整合 joint waveform，例如 communications + radar sensing，或 communications method 提供 timing information。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

R&S CMP200 › NR FR2 options 與 measurements
依 [[CMP200_Features_V8-14-22_en_09]] 與 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]：

| Code | Name / 原文說明 | Order no. | 相依關係 / 限制 |

| R&S CMP-KM601 | NR FR2 measurements, singlecarrier / NR mmWave measurements | 1212.1140.02 | NR FR2 measurements basic option |
| R&S CMP-KM603 | NR FR2 measurements, multicarrier / multi-carrier | 1212.2647.02 | 超過 1 carrier 需要此 option |
| R&S CMP-KM605 | NR FR2 measurements, two RX antennas / switched MIMO | 1212.3195.02 | Two RX antennas / switched MIMO |

NR FR2 multi-evaluation measurement 提供含 PUSCH 的 uplink signals 測試，measurement results 包含 Modulation、Spectrum、Power。Common settings 包含 number of carriers 1 to 4、operating band n257/n258/n259/n260/n261/n262、channel bandwidth 50/100/200/400 MHz、subcarrier spacing 60/120 kHz、duplex mode TDD、external attenuation –50 dB to 90 dB。

R&S CMP200
[[R&S CMP200]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**；依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，它與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head 組成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，並依 [[CMP200_Features_V8-14-22_en_09]] 透過 options 提供 [[NR FR2]]、[[UWB]]、[[LP-IoT]]、UWB PHY test plans、waveform playback/generation 與 [[R&S VSE]] analysis 相關功能。

R&S CMP200 › 產品定位
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head（RRH）形成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，目標應用為：

- R&D 的 RF parametric testing。
- Manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。
- Fully assembled smart devices 的 pure radiated mmWave setup。
- 具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup。
- 具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup。

CMP200 本體提供 IF frequency range 的 vector signal analysis 與 ARB-based generator functionality；[[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 作為 compact remote radio head，負責 upconversion / downconversion 至 5G NR FR2 frequencies。分離式 one-box tester + RRH 架構可在 mmWave frequency range 使用較短 RF cable lengths，以改善 radiated test environments 的 link budget。

R&S AREG800A › Level 與 IF transfer characteristics
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Dynamic RCS range for all artificial objects on one IF path：with [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 為 `90 dB`；with [[R&S QAT100]] 為 `> 60 dB`。

- RCS control step size：`0.1 dB`。
- Maximum input power at RX IF in connector of AREG800A base unit：`10 dBm (meas.)`。
- Recommended input power at RX IF in：`≤ 0 dBm (meas.)`。
- Maximum output power at TX IF out：`–3 dBm (meas.)`。
- IF attenuation accuracy of AREG800A base unit：`±2 dB (meas.)`。

Vector network analyzer 量測條件：frequency step size `2.5 MHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`，source power `–10 dBm`；span 依 bandwidth 為 `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`。

[[R&S AREG8-B9]] IF transfer characteristics：

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
